The remove-one-receipt control turned a GREEN fixture RED (removed command-center/confirmation/receipts/C-P0-ALPHA.json) and an open class-wide escalation blocked the gate at error_rate=0, so the gate is not a rubber stamp.

negative_controls.description: Delete C-P0-ALPHA.json from a known-green fixture; the gate must go RED on C-CENSUS.
Plant class_wide_escalation_open on a green fixture; the gate must go RED on C-ESCALATION even at error_rate=0.
An empty tree must not compute GREEN. Missing inventory is NOT-CHECKED/FAIL, never a vacuous pass.
Raise CNF-0118 disagreements above the pre-fixed threshold; C-ERROR-RATE must FAIL.

report.answer: No. Phase 11 is not finished. Live gate_verdict=RED phase_finished=False. C-CENSUS FAIL (empty-set-read-as-pass refused: p0p1_count=0). C-ERROR-RATE NOT-CHECKED (threshold receipt missing; rate not compared after the fact). C-ESCALATION NOT-CHECKED (escalation state unknown; open-escalation blocks regardless of pass rate). Residuals=9, each with a named settling experiment. A residual honestly scoped and disclosed does not block; an undisclosed one does. The remove-one-receipt control turned a GREEN fixture RED, so this gate is not a rubber stamp.
